_comment: Stub ownership + escalation config. The source of truth for who owns a service and where alerts go; prose docs (runbooks, READMEs) naming owners are not used. Values below are placeholders. Escalation is the 'notify' job in gate.yml (needs: gate, if: always()): it posts to Slack when any rule matches, and never changes the gate's outcome.

report-worker._note: Unowned since the platform migration (the runbook's owner and channel are dead). Resolves to fallback; D5 fires.

fallback._note: Used when a service has no owner or no channel. Also always copied on escalations for unowned services.

notification.targets: service slack_channel, or fallback.slack_channel if unset
notification.delivery: best-effort; a failed post is logged and retried but does not block or change the merge decision
